title: Hide Queue filter summary
summary: Hide the Queue display filter summary block from the operator UI while keeping its textContent available for existing diagnostics and smoke assertions.
reason: The Queue filter summary rendered a low-value guidance block above the Queue source inventory. It is redundant with nearby Queue controls and took visual space without changing backend launch scope.
behavior_before: Queue filter and scan summary prose could become visible after shared diagnostic-callout rendering rewrote the summary element.
behavior_after: Queue filter and scan summary prose stays hidden and display-suppressed, including after diagnostic-callout rendering, while the underlying DOM text remains available to tests.
tests_added: Updated Queue row-detail smoke assertion for display suppression.
Updated browser Launch/Queue readiness smoke assertion for computed display and client rects.
Updated static WebView assertion for the Queue CSS hide rule.
manual_validation: ops/pipeline/runtime/PowerShell-7.6.0-win-x64/pwsh.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ops/scripts/release/test.ps1 -SkipToolIntegration -SkipEndToEndSmoke (passed on rerun with longer timeout; first 180s attempt timed out before output)
rollback_plan: Remove the #queue-filter-summary CSS hide rule, remove the style.display assignment in setQueueFilterSummary, and revert the focused smoke/static assertion updates.
notes:
Hide the Queue filter summary after diagnostic-callout rendering so the operator does not see the non-actionable filter evidence block.

Assert Queue CSS forces the filter summary out of visual layout.
Browser smoke now verifies the Queue filter summary retains textContent but has no visual box.
